big: Nifty 500 is a snapshot of one slice of the market. Its factsheet answers four quick questions: how many stocks, what is the valuation, who is on top and how concentrated is it.

lines: The Nifty 500 index represents top 500 companies selected based on full market capitalization from the eligible universe. It holds 501 stocks and is rebalanced twice a year.

intro: NSE factsheet, 30 Sep 2026, as per the lesson. Past returns do not predict the future.
note: P/E is price relative to earnings. A higher P/E means investors pay more for each rupee of earnings.
